title: The Azure Mender's Signature Rite
summary: The signature rite of the Azure mender schools that gathers every lesser mend into one bright anointing of the whole soul.

title: The Twin Hearts Healing Rite
summary: A rite for two healers who beat as one and heal a patient's grief and wound with a single shared pulse.

title: The Basin Crowned Rite
summary: A rite in which the healer's Core fills like a basin to the brim and crowns the patient with the overflow.

title: The Sky Physician's Crowning Canon
summary: A crowning canon of the sky physicians that draws clear force from the heights of the Core and lays it over a failing soul.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Vow
summary: The great vow of the wind-sworn healers that binds the healer's own soul to the patient until the patient is whole.

title: The Oath-Voices' Healing Hymn
summary: A hymn handed down by the Oath-Voices in which every line of the verse sets a part of the soul in its place.

title: The Bearing of the Unbowed Healer
summary: A book on the true bearing of the healer who holds a steady line through any harm and will not bow to it.

title: The Open Sky Rite of Return
summary: A rite for bringing home a soul that the open sky has half claimed and lays a fallen patient gently back in the body.
